slots.notes: Fullscreen object-cover background video for the hero; autoplay, muted, playsInline, no dark overlay. Crossfades to black ~1.5s before end and fades back in over first 1s on restart via requestAnimationFrame, so it must read as a seamless ambient loop.

mechanic: Fixed transparent navbar over a full-viewport-height fullscreen object-cover background video that requestAnimationFrame-crossfades through black for a seamless loop, with bottom-aligned centered hero content (badge, heading, paragraph, dual CTAs).
techDelivery: plain React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS with Lucide icons (ArrowUpRight, Menu/X)
reskinNotes: All copy is hardcoded in markup. Colors are declared as space-separated HSL triplets in CSS variables (not hex), so a reskin must supply matching HSL components, and --muted-foreground / --border carry baked-in alpha. The seamless-loop fade timing (1.5s / 0.3s / 1s) is hand-tuned to the specific source video's duration and must be re-tuned per replacement clip. Heading uses fixed px sizes (62/48/36) rather than fluid scale, so longer brand headlines can overflow the 603px content column.
